# vendor

Third-party code, committed rather than installed, so the project keeps its
promise: clone it, serve the folder, play. No build step, no `npm install`,
and it works with the network unplugged.

- **three.module.js** — three.js r160, the minified ES module build, taken
  from the `three@0.160.0` npm package (`build/three.module.min.js`).
  MIT licensed; the licence text is in `three.LICENSE`.
